calculation.description: Ranks assets for five-day forward returns using the negative five-day return normalized by each asset's 20-day realized volatility. The signal is active only when cross-asset daily-return dispersion exceeds its trailing 60-day median. Higher values indicate stronger recent underperformance adjusted for risk, conditional on a high-dispersion regime.

validation.regime_notes: Signal was active on 75 dates, concentrated in 2025-26 (56 dates; 1-day diagnostic IC 0.031193, ICIR 0.105462) and 2027 YTD (19 dates; 1-day diagnostic IC -0.042362, ICIR -0.152411). Five-day admission statistics are pooled and uncertainty is material due to sparse activation.
